faqs.q: Can I request a service without membership?
faqs.a: Yes, you can request a service without membership, you will only have to pay the initial visit. No discounts are applied when paying for the service.

faqs.q: How can I request a service?
faqs.a: To request a service go to the Dashboard and select the type of service you need. If you don't have a membership, you will have to pay for the initial visit. Then the technician will make the diagnosis and quote, if you reject it, it will be assigned to another technician, if you accept it, we proceed with the service.

faqs.q: What are the accepted payment methods?
faqs.a: Currently only bank transfers and CRYPTO

faqs.q: What is the response time for support?
faqs.a: Our support team handles queries within a maximum of 48 business hours.

faqs.q: Do you offer a warranty for the services?
faqs.a: Yes, all our services include a 30-day warranty. If the problem persists after our intervention, we will return at no additional cost.

faqs.q: How can I cancel or reschedule a service?
faqs.a: You can cancel a service as long as you haven't accepted the quote. To reschedule a service, you must cancel the service and request it when you need it.
